note: Paths are kebab-case, wrapper keys are snake_case. The two spellings of `javascript_errors` are the whole reason this file exists as a lookup rather than a naming rule.
base_url_note: Every path below is appended to the configured API base URL, which already carries the version prefix.
endpoints_note: `page_visits` is sent by `ranetrace/ranetrace-laravel` only. `ranetrace/ranetrace-php` sends the other four, and its endpoint table holds those four.
